description: Add and manage comments on Windows folders.

releases.release_notes:
# 🎉 Release v1.0.0 (Initial Release)

We are excited to announce the first official release of the **Folder Comments Shell Extension**! 

This tool integrates seamlessly into Windows Explorer, allowing you to easily view, add, and edit custom folder comments directly from the native Windows **Folder Properties** dialog. 

### ✨ Key Features
* **Native Explorer Integration:** Adds a dedicated Comments tab to the properties dialog of any directory.
* **Windows InfoTip Support:** Comments are saved safely using native Windows APIs (). Your text will appear as a tooltip when you hover over the folder in Explorer.
* **Massive Multilingual Support:** UI translated and ready for over 40+ global languages, including automatic Right-to-Left (RTL) layout switching. *(See full list below).*
* **Built-in Auto-Updater:** Automatically checks GitHub for new versions in the background. Features a non-intrusive UI to Update Now, Remind Me Later, or Ignore a specific version.
* **Clickable About Section:** Direct links to visit the official website or contact support via email directly from the tab.

### 🌍 Multilingual Support (44 Languages)
The extension automatically adapts to your system language. Supported languages include:

**Right-to-Left (RTL) Fully Supported:**  
Arabic, Farsi, Hebrew

**Left-to-Right (LTR) Supported:**  
Afrikaans, Albanian, Basque, Belarusian, Bulgarian, Catalan, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Faeroese, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese.

### 🛡️ Stability & Architecture
Because shell extensions run directly inside , stability is a top priority in this release:
* **Crash Protection:** Wrapped with strict memory and lifecycle management to ensure the DLL safely unloads and prevents memory leaks.
* **Failsafe Cleanups:** Handles COM object reference counting flawlessly so Windows Explorer never freezes or crashes when closing the properties window.
* **Debug Logging:** Includes a built-in, thread-safe diagnostic logger. If you ever encounter an issue, a detailed  is generated in the DLL directory to make troubleshooting easy.

### 💬 Feedback & Support
If you encounter any bugs, localization issues, or have feature requests, please [open an issue](../../issues) on our GitHub repository. 

**Enjoy the release!** 🚀
